pronunciation_overrides.SQLite: ˌɛskjuˌɛlˈIt (ess-cue-ell-ite; not in the misaki lexicon)

lines.text: It said saved. Then the power died. Is your note still there?
Good databases write it down first.
Each change goes into a log on disk, then the app says saved.
The main file is updated later. After a crash, the log is replayed.
In our test, [SQLite](/ˌɛskjuˌɛlˈIt/) crashed mid-save. Both committed notes came back.
Faster settings can lose the last few commits in a power cut.
So saved means logged. For data you can't lose, keep full sync.
